objective: To create the monthly PR per Logistics Partner: Monthly PR - Fixed Cost (E-Catalogue Monthly Cost) and Route-Based PR for LP operations.
To calculate the route-based plan from Route Percentage, TMMIN Calendar working days, Order Sharing (Master KPI) and E-Catalogue Mileage Cost, and show it per LP.
To support additional PR sequences without duplicated cost components, follow the creation period rule and start the existing PR approval (SH skipped when the Section Head creates the PR).

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display and Creation Period (PC-02, PC-03)
Defaults: Route-Based PR, Operational Month = system month + 1, All Logistics Partners; the plan is calculated on open.
Authorization configuration: VPLD Staff and VPLD Section Head may create PR; other users get view only (message no. 17).
Period: Month N+1 allowed (created in N-1). Month N only when System Master parameter = allowed (not configured: no. 4; not allowed: no. 5). Past: no. 6; after N+1: no. 7 (TBD, OP-04).
5.2 Data Sources

rows: priceForPR: covers the month, not expired, unique
Per operational month (per LP TBD, OP-02)

operation.text: 5.3 Route-Based Calculation (TBD confirmation, OP-01)

items: Monthly orders = Order Sharing × Working Days.
Orders per route = monthly orders split by Route Percentage (largest remainder; ties by higher %, then code). Total below 100%: split proportionally (TBD, OP-07).
Planned Cost = orders × distance (Km) × Mileage Cost (IDR/Km), rounded to IDR.
Delivery Cost (IDR/Day) = Σ Planned Cost ÷ Working Days; Monthly Delivery Cost = Fixed Cost + Σ Planned Cost.
Example DNX Dec 2026: 4 × 22 = 88 orders; DPCMR_CYKRW 15% = 14 orders × 57 Km × 2,700 = 2,154,600.

operation.text: 5.4 PR Amount per Type
Monthly PR - Fixed Cost: component FIX; amount = Monthly Cost; Mileage Cost shown as reference rate. After PO the Monthly Cost goes directly to SA (TBD, OP-06).
Route-Based PR: components ROUTE:{code} for routes with orders > 0 not yet in active PRs; amount = Σ Planned Cost of those routes.
Errors per LP: calendar (no. 8), routes (no. 9), Order Sharing (no. 10 / 11), price (no. 12), amount <= 0 (no. 15).
5.5 PR Sequence and Duplicate Components (PC-06 to PC-08)
Sequence = MAX(PR_SEQ) of LP + Operational Month (all statuses) + 1; each PR has its own PR number; sequence > 1 stores PARENT_PR_NO = sequence 1.
Used components = components of PRs of LP + month whose status is not Rejected / Returned. FIX used: no. 13; all planned routes used: no. 14.
Previous PRs are never changed.
5.6 Create PR (PC-10 to PC-12)

items: Create PR (or Confirm in the pop-up): confirmation no. 19 with LPs, sequences, amounts, total and approval path.
Loading indicator; for each LP recalculate and re-check sequence and components in the same transaction.
Insert PR header, details, approval levels and history (Data Map). Sequence taken meanwhile: no. 20.
Approval levels from the workflow configuration: levels up to the creator's level = Skip. VPLD Staff: SH -> DpH -> DH. VPLD Section Head: SH Skip, starts at DpH; SH cannot approve the PR.
Success: no. 21; rows show 'Created {PR No} ({status})'. Failed LPs: no. 22. Exception: rollback, no. 25.

operation.text: 5.7 PR Detail Pop-up
Header info; route table (Route, Route %, Number of Orders, Working Days, Distance, Planned Cost, PR) or cost components for Fixed Cost; Total Cost. Scrolls with sticky header / footer.
Routes already in an active PR are grey ('In {PR No}'). Close; Confirm & Create PR enabled when the row is Ready and the user is authorized.
5.8 Export
List Summary (.xls) and Route Plan Detail (.xls) of the filtered rows (no. 23); before Generate: no. 24.
5.9 After Creation
The PR appears in PR Approval / PR Inquiry (Production Month MM/YYYY-seq). Detail shows type, sequence, initial PR, working days and next process; download CSV per PR.
Approval, PO creation and auto approval follow the existing workflow (monthly-pr-po-rules.md).
